script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Pawan Tyres se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost saade teen saal se — 1255 din — lekin pichle 30 dinon mein platform pe ek bhi active day record nahi hua, toh sochaa ek baar seedha baat karte hain.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — jab bhi koi buyer aapko inquiry bhejta hai, reply karne mein kya dikkat aati hai? Kyunki abhi aapka reply rate sirf 10.3% dikh raha hai, matlab 10 mein se sirf 1 lead ka jawab ja raha hai — kya time nahi milta, ya leads relevant nahi lag rahe?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek cheez share karta hoon — aapka CQS score 82 hai, jo actually achha hai, matlab aapka catalog strong hai. Aur aapki 64.9% PNS success rate bhi theek hai. Problem sirf engagement ki hai — agar aap sirf un leads ko bhi reply karein jo already aa rahi hain, toh conversion naturally upar jayega bina koi extra investment ke.
script_parts.action: Chaliye abhi ek kaam karte hain — main aapko IndiaMART app pe Lead Manager dikhata hoon, wahan jo pending inquiries hain unhe ek saath dekh lete hain aur ek quick reply template set kar dete hain taaki aage se reply karna 2 minute ka kaam ho jaye.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, koi bada commitment nahi maang raha — bas agle 7 din mein ek baar daily 5 minute Lead Manager check karna, aur jo bhi inquiry aaye uspe reply karna. Ek hafte baad main phir call karta hoon dekhne ke liye ki kuch fark pada ya nahi — theek lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with Pawan Tyres? This is IndiaMART calling — I was reviewing your account and noticed that while you've been with us for 1,255 days, there have been zero active days on the platform in the last 30 days, so I wanted to have a direct conversation about what's going on.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — when buyers send you inquiries, what's making it difficult to respond? Because right now your reply rate is only 10.3%, meaning only 1 out of every 10 leads is getting a response — is it a time issue, or are the leads not feeling relevant to your business?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something worth noting — your CQS score is 82, which means your catalog is actually in good shape, and your PNS success rate is 64.9%. The only gap is engagement — if you simply start replying to the leads that are already coming in, your conversion will improve without any additional investment.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll walk you through the Lead Manager section on the IndiaMART app, we'll look at the pending inquiries together, and set up a quick reply template so that responding to future leads takes no more than 2 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not asking for any big commitment — just 5 minutes a day on Lead Manager for the next 7 days, and a reply to any inquiry that comes in. I'll call you again in a week to check if there's been any difference — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
